behaviors.behavior: An FR whose bound test files are untouched since a verified ancestor promotes, and the ledger names that anchor (anchor_commit) beside ci_run_id
The same FR does NOT promote once one of its bound test files is touched in A..HEAD -- it skips with reason evidence_stale_since_anchor, spec.md is left untouched, and the ledger gets no new entry
A HEAD with no verified ancestor inside the bound reports unavailable, not an error and not a promotion (rc==0, nothing promoted); a query error walking candidates degrades the same way, never exit 2
The existing tip-is-verified path promotes IDENTICALLY when the tip IS verified; all pre-existing test_promote_required_layers.py behaviors are unchanged
behaviors.evidence: test_promote_required_layers.py::test_tip_is_verified_never_triggers_the_anchor_fallback_at_all PASSED, plus 34 pre-existing tests unmodified and green

behaviors.behavior: Anchor resolution's four outcomes (found-at-tip, found-at-ancestor, unavailable, error) are each independently exercised
A run of 5+ consecutive query errors gives up (circuit breaker) rather than walking the full bound; non-consecutive errors never trip it
head_commit's case is normalised (lowercased) before use in the git log call and in the returned commit/detail

evidence_stale_since_anchor is true when the FR's identity (manifest node id) differs between anchor and head, even with no path-level diff -- closes the doubt-review HIGH finding that only diffed paths, never re-verified identity

evidence_stale_since_anchor is true when a NEW test file changed in A..HEAD that looks like a test path but is not yet bound to any FR in either manifest -- catches the anchor-manifest's un-regenerated blind spot
evidence_stale_since_anchor stays false when an unrelated non-test file changes in A..HEAD
_looks_like_test_path recognises pytest conventions (test_*.py, *_test.py, anything under a tests/ dir, both POSIX and Windows separators) and rejects everything else

The anchor's own execution evidence erroring or being unavailable degrades gracefully (rc==0, FR skipped) rather than a fatal exit 2 -- reversed from the Stage-2 code-review round after doubt-review disproved the content-binding-vs-transient distinction
bound_test_files extracts the file half of a path/id test link, tolerating malformed links
changed_paths_between lists real changed files, empty on identical commits, None on git failure, and keeps a renamed file's OLD path visible (--no-renames)
manifest_at_commit reads the exact commit (not the working tree), raises on an unresolvable HEAD/commit/missing-path/invalid-JSON
append_decision/record_ledger_entries carry anchor_commit when given, omit it when absent
